name: Loaded Sweet Potato Ground Beef Bowl

components.name: Seasoned Ground Beef
steps: While potatoes cook, season minced beef with garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper.
Brown beef fully in a hot nonstick pan, breaking it into small pieces. Drain if necessary.

components.name: Baked Sweet Potatoes
steps: Bake washed sweet potatoes at 200°C for about 50–65 minutes until the centres are soft. This is a SECONDARY OVEN lane even though beef uses stovetop.
Cut the baked potatoes and spoon beef over them.

components.name: Eggs
steps: For multi-day meal prep cook eggs all the way through (scrambled or hard-boiled); the original over-easy eggs are only suitable fresh.

components.name: Cottage Cheese
steps: Divide egg and cottage cheese across four bowls.

components.name: Avocado
steps: Keep avocado separate and slice close to eating rather than freezing or heating it.
Heat beef, potato and cooked egg as hot components; serve with cold cottage cheese and avocado.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; quantities, macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Needs a second appliance: the sweet potatoes bake in the oven.
Freezer: Freeze beef and baked sweet potato; do not freeze avocado or assembled dairy/egg topping.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
